description: The second season settles into a permanent British tent while sending the trio across Switzerland, North America, Europe and Mozambique for supercar battles, engineering disasters and long-distance challenges.

s02e01.description: In Switzerland, the trio compare the Lamborghini Aventador S, Honda NSX and electric Rimac Concept One in a past-versus-present-versus-future supercar battle that ends dramatically for Richard.

s02e02.description: Jeremy races a Ford GT from New York to Niagara Falls against James and an injured Richard using public transport, while the Mercedes-AMG GT R gets an Eboladrome test.

s02e03.description: Jeremy takes the Bugatti Chiron across Europe, James races a Kia Stinger against gravity and Richard and James invent car-park racing to make lunch breaks less dull.

s02e04.description: Starting in Croatia with an Audi TT RS, Ariel Nomad and Lada fire engine, the trio attempt to make an entirely unscripted film and promptly demonstrate why planning exists.

s02e05.description: Jeremy attempts a Ken Block-style farm video in an old Subaru, James tests the Volkswagen Up GTI and Richard tries the high-speed Ripsaw tracked vehicle.

s02e06.description: Old Jaguars cross Colorado through dirt-track laps, altitude performance tests and car-based skiing as the trio attempt to prove that cheap Jaguars can be both roguish and dependable.

s02e07.description: Richard and James invent a way to refuel a car without stopping, Jeremy revisits Audi versus Lancia in the 1983 World Rally Championship and the Lamborghini Huracan Performante attacks the track.

s02e08.description: Jeremy and Richard visit historic motorsport sites in recreation Aston Martin DB4 GT and Jaguar XKSS models before James arrives in a modern Civic Type R to spoil the nostalgia.

s02e09.description: The trio build a road-legal amphibious car around a jet engine and attempt a British water-speed record, while Jeremy revisits the Jaguar XJ220 and Bugatti EB110.

s02e10.description: Three performance SUVs face tracks, enormous dogs and snowy Canadian mountains, while Jeremy tests the Tesla Model X under unusually lawyer-aware conditions.

s02e11.description: The trio try to transport fish from Mozambique's coast to the interior using wildly unsuitable vehicles, discovering that mud, heat and dead fish are not ideal logistics partners.
